control: do_write qualify: wr_en && (!full || rd_en) so write-when-full succeeds only with same-cycle read
overflow next: wr_en && full && !rd_en, registered for one cycle
underflow next: rd_en && empty, registered for one cycle
count next select: +1 on write-only, -1 on read-only, hold on both-or-neither
full comparator: count == DEPTH, empty comparator: count == 0, almost_full comparator: count >= AF_THRESH
synchronous active-high rst override with priority over read/write/count/flags
datapath: DEPTH x WIDTH storage array mem written as mem[wr_ptr] <= din on do_write
registered read path mem[rd_ptr] -> dout on do_read else dout holds value
wr_ptr binary increment on do_write with modulo-DEPTH wrap to 0
rd_ptr binary increment on do_read with modulo-DEPTH wrap to 0
count occupancy register update driving full/empty/almost_full status

elements.name: mem
elements.role: DEPTH entries of WIDTH bits circular buffer holding queued words in arrival order

elements.name: wr_ptr
elements.role: write index 0..DEPTH-1 pointing to next free slot for din

elements.name: rd_ptr
elements.role: read index 0..DEPTH-1 pointing to oldest stored word for dout

elements.name: count
elements.role: occupancy count 0..DEPTH driving full/empty/almost_full combinational status

elements.name: dout
elements.role: registered read data holding oldest word on do_read else holding previous value, reset to 0

elements.name: full
elements.role: combinational status 1 when count==DEPTH gating do_write and overflow

elements.name: empty
elements.role: combinational status 1 when count==0 gating do_read

elements.name: overflow
elements.role: registered one-cycle pulse for write-ignored-when-full without same-cycle read

elements.name: underflow
elements.role: registered one-cycle pulse for any rd_en when empty including empty simultaneous RW

elements.name: do_write
elements.role: internal qualified write enable wr_en && (!full || rd_en)

breakdown.pointer_scheme: Binary wr_ptr and rd_ptr over 0..DEPTH-1 with modulo-DEPTH wrap to 0 after DEPTH-1; wr_ptr advances by 1 only on do_write, rd_ptr advances by 1 only on do_read, both advance together on simultaneous read-write including full case so count stays DEPTH and order is preserved across wrap; occupancy tracked separately by count (+1 write-only, -1 read-only, hold both-or-neither) with full/empty decoded from count not pointer equality, so no extra full/empty pointer ambiguity.
breakdown.summary: Circular-buffer single-clock FIFO with DEPTHxWIDTH memory, binary wrap pointers, occupancy counter for combinational full/empty/almost_full, registered dout with hold on empty read, and one-cycle overflow/underflow pulses; no FSM.
timing_assumptions: Inputs clk, rst, wr_en, rd_en, din sampled at rising edge of clk
Synchronous active-high rst takes priority and empties FIFO with count 0 and dout/overflow/underflow 0 on that edge
Registered outputs dout, count, overflow, underflow change just after rising edge using pre-edge full/empty/count
Combinational outputs full, empty, almost_full continuously decode current count as full=(count==DEPTH), empty=(count==0), almost_full=(count>=AF_THRESH)
Simultaneous read-write ordering resolved in same cycle using pre-edge status per do_read/do_write equations
